Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that cover a range of sub‑genres—from supernatural chills to psychological dread and outright gore. Pick whatever mood strikes you!

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑Genre | Quick Synopsis |

| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological Thriller | A secretary’s escape leads her to a secluded motel run by a disturbed proprietor—shocking twists abound. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Supernatural / Psychological | A family stays at an isolated hotel where the father descends into madness under the influence of a malevolent presence. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher | A masked killer stalks teenagers on Halloween night; the film set the template for the slasher genre. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Paranormal / Religious Horror | Two priests attempt to exorcise a young girl possessed by a demonic entity. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Psychological / Supernatural | After a grandmother dies, a family uncovers dark secrets and a terrifying legacy. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social Commentary / Psychological | A Black man visits his white girlfriend’s family estate, uncovering a sinister plot. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi Horror | In a world where sound attracts deadly creatures, a family must live in silence. |
| 8 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Modern Urban Legend | A curse passes through sexual encounters, manifesting as a relentless, shape‑changing pursuer. |
| 9 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | A couple travels to Sweden for a midsummer festival that turns into a ritualistic nightmare. |
|10 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Supernatural / Mystery | Watching a cursed videotape leads to death after seven days; a journalist investigates. |
|11 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found Footage / Paranormal | Home video footage captures a haunting that escalates over time. |
|12 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Supernatural | A mother and son confront a sinister children's book character that threatens their sanity. |
|13 | **28 Days Later** | 2002 | Post‑Apocalyptic / Zombie | A virus outbreak turns humans into rage‑driven zombies; survivors fight to stay alive. |
|14 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | A group of friends in a remote cabin unwittingly triggers a series of horrific events orchestrated by unseen forces. |
|15 | **Suspiria** | 1977 | Gothic / Supernatural | A dance academy hides a coven of witches; a student discovers the truth behind the school's dark rituals. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a particular era, sub‑genre, or rating!
